'''Gosse''' was a [[Selonian/Legends|Selonian]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] loyalist to the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] living during the [[Galactic War]].

==Biography==
During the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire's]] [[Battle of Corellia|invasion]] on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]], Gosse was among the many aliens that joined the [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] resistance in their conquest to defeat the Empire. However, she and [[Corellian Security Force|CorSec]] [[Officer/Legends|Officer]] [[Cole Cantarus]] were captured by Empire and imprisoned in an Imperial-held CorSec station in the nearby [[Entertainment Plaza]].

After learning of this, [[General/Legends|General]] [[Aves]] sent a Republic hero to assault the facility and rescue both Gosse and Cantarus from their imprisonment. After her rescue, she delivered valuable information to the General and [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] forces about the other [[Selonian/Legends|Selonians]] that were trapped and been held by Imperial forces and allowed the Republic hero to get inside the [[Coronet Shipping]].
